notes: Large-source-unit check: kol + lōʾ → none is the chapter's only multi-source unit. One English word carries both the universal and the negation, exactly as rule 35's kol-āḏām lōʾ-yihyeh → no man does, so it is genuinely indivisible and is headed on the negative; the noun keeps its own of her vows.
The two of's before her vows and her bonds are the construct relation borne by each coordinated rectum under rule 19, not one distributed function word.

bəyôm + infinitive is counted under rule 52: bə takes in, yôm takes the day, and the second temporal word answers to the construct relation and goes to the infinitive, whose suffix takes the subject pronoun he.
